next_step_mapping.RM Priority Lead: Route to RM within 48 hours with value talking points and product rationale.
next_step_mapping.Campaign Target: Push into the next campaign wave with personalization tags and channel controls.
next_step_mapping.Digital Nurture: Start a lighter digital journey and rescore after the next engagement signal refresh.
next_step_mapping.Hold / Defer: Keep out of the active audience until new engagement or relationship signals arrive.
next_step_mapping.Suppress: Suppress outreach. Address service, compliance, or contact-fatigue constraints before reactivating.
